import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='Gender', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Gender')

# Plot 2: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.1f', padding=3)

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level colored by BMI Category
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Stress Level',
                hue='BMI Category', palette='Set2', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by BMI', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Handle NaN values by replacing with 'None'
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel')[:len(sleep_disorder_counts)]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
                                    labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index,
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(sleep_disorder_counts),
                                    startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
